The assigned matrices B_a(x,j)=ψ(ax)χ_e(x)^(−j), augmented by a zero-frequency row for the 9D case, follow the paper’s harmonic EITFF matrix constructions up to invertible common scalars. Independent exhaustive modular Gaussian elimination at the embedding Z[ζ24]→F97, ζ24↦4 (order24), verifies 126 four-block matrices of rank8 for EACH odd exponent, and every subset k=1..6 for each even exponent, exactly 1,899 modular rank calculations. A nonzero minor modulo97 proves a nonzero characteristic-zero minor, i.e. lower rank bound ONLY. Independent exact arithmetic in Z[i,ω] verifies all six supplied kernel witnesses: 4-square right null vectors for rank≤7 and 5-complement left null vectors for rank≤8 for e=2,4,6. F9 affine translations/dilations preserve selected-block rank and move canonical square {±1,±t} through 18 sets; its complement furnishes the 18 exceptional five-blocks. All lower and upper bounds and large-subset monotonicity match ranks: 8D min(2|S|,8); 9D 2k for k≤3, at k4 ranks7 on 18 squares else8, k5 ranks8 on 18 complements else9, k≥6 rank9. Finite exhaustive proof is valid for the finite F9 family only.
